method: For each of the 42 census rows, read git log provenance of the current mq5/ex5/setfile vs the row-bound (expected) sha256.
Cross-checked D:/QM/strategy_farm/state/farm_state.sqlite work_item_supersedes for an existing governed successor (the census generator does NOT do this join -- see defect note).

For rows with an ex5 finding (binary actually drifted), queried work_items WHERE kind='compile' AND phase='COMPILE_EA' AND status='done' AND verdict='COMPILE_OK' AND ex5_sha256=<current actual sha256>, cross-checked mq5_sha256 in the same receipt (this is the exact predicate tools/strategy_farm/validate_ex5_commit_guard.py enforces pre-commit, so a match is authoritative 'committed governed rebuild with COMPILE_OK evidence').

For rows without an ex5 finding, verified directly (hash the on-disk .ex5, compare to payload_json.expected_ex5_sha256) that the bound EX5 is byte-identical to what dispatch already tests -- only the mq5/setfile source text drifted, so there is no compiled successor artifact to bind.

For the LINE_ENDINGS_ONLY setfile finding (row 8be76d81), computed CRLF->LF normalization of the current bytes and confirmed it reproduces the bound sha256 exactly (validate_ex5_commit_guard.py-style proof).

defect_found.summary: census.json (and pending_binding_rebind_plan.py's rebind_plan.json) do not consult work_item_supersedes before flagging GOVERNED_BUILD_SUCCESSOR_REQUIRED. 23 of the 42 flagged rows already have a recorded supersession (most via farmctl.requalify-q02 or DL-089/july-cohort/orphan-lane dispositions dated 2026-08-24 through 2026-09-18). The census disposition on those 23 rows is stale as of 2026-09-19. Separately, rebind_plan.json's C2A_COMMITTED_REGENERATION_STALE_BINDING filter found 0 rows because plan.json's row shape (work_item_id/ea_id keys) does not match what pending_binding_rebind_plan.py expects (id/ea/cause_cluster) -- rebind_eligible_count=0 is a schema-mismatch no-op, not a real finding. Recommend: (1) add a work_item_supersedes join to the census generator so resolved rows stop re-alerting; (2) fix or retire pending_binding_rebind_plan.py's input contract.
